# watchpoint_log_archive_destination (Resource)

Where the tenant's logs are archived: each closed UTC day is written hour by hour as gzip JSONL under `watchpoint-logs/<tenant>/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/hour=HH/service=NAME/`, readable by Athena, Spark or Synapse in place and rehydratable into Watchpoint. A per-tenant singleton. Requires the `log_archives` feature (Scale). Credentials are write-only and kept in state from configuration; changing the destination starts a new archive from yesterday.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Archive closed days of logs to S3 as gzip JSONL. Declare once per tenant.
resource "watchpoint_log_archive_destination" "this" {
  type              = "s3"
  bucket            = "acme-watchpoint-logs"
  region            = "us-east-1"
  access_key_id     = var.log_archive_access_key_id
  secret_access_key = var.log_archive_secret_access_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) `azure_blob` or `s3` (AWS or any S3-compatible store).

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) `s3`: access key id.
- `bucket` (String) `s3`: bucket name. AWS buckets with dots are not supported.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether archiving runs. Defaults to `true`.
- `endpoint` (String) `s3`: https endpoint with no path for an S3-compatible store (MinIO, R2). Omit for AWS.
- `region` (String) `s3`: region, for example `us-east-1` (`auto` for R2). Required for AWS; defaults to `us-east-1` with a custom `endpoint`.
- `sas_url` (String, Sensitive) `azure_blob`: container SAS URL, `https://<account>.blob.core.windows.net/<container>?sv=...&sig=...`. The query string is the credential.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) `s3`: secret access key.

### Read-Only

- `base_url` (String) Resolved destination URL, without the credential.
- `id` (String) Tenant ID, which this setting is keyed on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_log_archive_destination.this <tenant_id>
```
